THE CONNECTED WORKSPACE

What is the GriidAi platform?

GriidAi is an AI-guided geospatial workspace that connects data, spatial analysis, execution planning, human review, mapping, and outputs in one environment. Users can define a spatial question, work with geospatial data, review a proposed implementation plan, run supported analytical steps, inspect the results, and continue or export the analysis without treating every question as a completely separate GIS project.

The platform is designed to make spatial work easier to organize and repeat while keeping expert judgment inside the workflow.

How it worksWorkspaceAgentic GeoAIAnalysisOutputs
01 / THE WORKFLOW

From intent to a result you can inspect and use.

  1. 01

    Define intent

    Describe the location-based question, task, or analytical outcome you need.

  2. 02

    Bring or find data

    Use data already in the workspace, upload your own, or discover relevant sources when supported.

  3. 03

    Generate a plan

    GriidAi proposes an implementation plan using the selected data and supported geospatial operations.

  4. 04

    Review

    Check the inputs, method, validation strategy, and expected outputs before execution.

  5. 05

    Execute

    Approve the analytical step and let the platform run the supported spatial operations.

  6. 06

    Validate

    Inspect the map, tables, statistics, intermediate outputs, and final analytical result.

  7. 07

    Map / export

    Present the result on the map or export communication and analytical outputs for the next step.

  8. 08

    Continue

    Use the result, trusted data, and session context to continue the next question or related analysis.

03 / AGENTIC PLANNING

AI helps organize the work before it runs.

When a supported analytical step requires execution, GriidAi can prepare an implementation plan that makes the proposed work visible before processing begins. Review the selected inputs, method, validation strategy, and expected output, then approve the step when it matches your intent.

This keeps the AI useful without turning spatial analysis into an unexplained black box.

07 / HUMAN-GUIDED RELIABILITY

Keep expert judgment inside the workflow.

GriidAi is designed to help experts move faster without hiding the analytical choices that shape the result. The user defines the intent, reviews the proposed plan, approves supported execution steps, and validates the output before deciding how it should be used.

For geospatial work, this matters because projections, units, joins, time windows, topology, data quality, and analytical assumptions can all change the meaning of a result.

09 / WORKSPACE CONTINUITY

Continue the analysis without rebuilding the workspace.

GriidAi stores chat sessions and keeps session-specific layers and results organized so users can work through multiple lines of analysis. Trusted data can also be shared between sessions, reducing repeated upload and helping separate data-preparation work from later business questions.

  • ↳Session history and search
  • ↳Session-specific project layers
  • ↳Temporary and intermediate files separated from final outputs
  • ↳Shared trusted data reused in another session
  • ↳Workspace-aware selection of available data
10 / MULTILINGUAL INTERACTION

Work with the platform in more than one language.

Spatial analysis should not depend on writing every instruction in one language. GriidAi has demonstrated text-based interaction in multiple languages while keeping the requested spatial action consistent across the workspace.
